about.purpose: Measured Windows 11 geometry. The shell is checked against these numbers by tools/visual/parity.py; nothing here is guessed.
about.regenerate: python3 tools/visual/measure_reference.py  (--check verifies the taskbar and Start numbers against the committed capture)

taskbar_explorer_settings_notifications_.file: private captures supplied by the maintainer on 2026-08-26
taskbar_explorer_settings_notifications_.note: desktop, Explorer, Settings, notification centre and context menu were measured from the maintainer's own screenshots. Those files show a personal desktop and are deliberately NOT committed: only the measurements below survive.

taskbar_widgets_quick_settings.file: private captures supplied by the maintainer on 2026-08-26 (second set)
taskbar_widgets_quick_settings.note: the full-width taskbar, the keyboard-layout flyout and Quick Settings were measured from the maintainer's own screenshots; the files are deliberately NOT committed, only these numbers.

public_library.note: Public Microsoft screenshots (Microsoft Learn, Microsoft support, Windows blogs). Not committed — copyright Microsoft; tools/visual/fetch_references.py re-downloads them by URL and verifies the recorded sha256.

clipboard.file: private capture supplied by the maintainer on 2026-08-26 (Win+V panel)
clipboard.note: the clipboard flyout was measured from the maintainer's own screenshot: panel 448 px wide, cards 96 px tall with an 18 px gutter, 26 px from the panel edge to a card. Divided by 1.25 those are 360 / 76 / 8 / 20. The file is deliberately NOT committed; only these numbers are.

game_bar.file: private capture supplied by the maintainer on 2026-08-26 (Win+G «Записать» widget)
game_bar.note: measured off the maintainer's own screenshot: the widget is 383 px wide and 274 px tall, its four tiles are 70 px squares on a 90 px pitch, the first tile starts 21 px from the panel edge, the tile row starts 66 px below the panel top and the footer row is 82 px tall. Divided by 1.25: 306 x 219, tile 56, pitch 72, padding 17, header 53, footer 66. The file is deliberately NOT committed; only these numbers are. The floating bar in the same shot is 654 x 67 px = 523 x 54 logical.

snap_layouts.file: assets/refs/win11/cache/WIN11_22H2_CML_JIT_TouchAssist_SnapLayouts_Flow-1_HERO_16x9_en-US_1920.png (library id snap-layouts-flyout, published by Microsoft on blogs.windows.com)
snap_layouts.note: The capture is 1920x1080 and its taskbar measures 47 px tall against the documented 48, so it is a 100 % capture and its pixels are logical pixels. The snap bar in it is 672 px wide and holds six layout thumbnails of 96x62 px on a 14 px gap with 13 px panel padding; inside a thumbnail the cells are separated by 6 px. Dividing the measured cell widths by the thumbnail content width (96 - gaps) gives exactly the six Windows 11 layouts: 1/2+1/2, 2/3+1/3, 1/2 + two stacked quarters, four quadrants, three thirds and 1/4+1/2+1/4. Re-derived by tools/visual/measure_library.py.

context_menu.note: Windows 11 sizes a context menu to its widest row; 300 is the measured floor, not a fixed width. Confirmed on the public 100 %-scale capture quick-access-update2.png, whose file menu is narrower than the desktop menu.

game_bar.gap_from_edge_note: ours, not Windows': the game bar widget is draggable, so its position in the capture says nothing. The panel sits Theme.flyoutGap (12) from the top-left corner like every other Zaldros flyout.

bar.note: the floating bar measured from the same capture: 654 x 67 px at 125 % = 523 x 54, the widget field 279 px = 223 wide with five buttons, buttons on a 50 px = 40 pitch. Our field holds three buttons (no Xbox friends, no Edge) and is sized to them, like Windows sizes it to its own.

task_manager._derivation: Производная от уже измеренных токенов Windows 11 (Explorer/Settings): подлинного снимка Task Manager в библиотеке эталонов пока нет. Не измерение — производная, см. ADR-0016.

snap_layouts.zones_note: Fractions of the work area (screen minus taskbar), in the order the thumbnails appear in the capture. Derived from the measured cell widths, not chosen.
snap_layouts.anchor_note: Windows opens this flyout under the maximise caption button; the 8 px gap below the title bar is ours — the capture shows the drag-to-top snap bar, whose position says nothing about the flyout's.
